module.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Client
module.description: Tiny Python pod that POSTs varied prompts to the BNK Gateway at a Poisson rate. Emits client-side Prometheus metrics (latency, request-rate, which model served).

required.reason: Client targets the Gateway VIP the backend module creates

required.name: gateway_url
required.description: Full base URL the client POSTs to. Wired from backend module's gateway_url output.

optional.name: replicas
optional.description: How many client pods. Each runs independent Poisson loops.

optional.name: request_rate
optional.description: Target requests/sec per pod (Poisson mean — naturally bursty).

optional.name: max_tokens
optional.description: max_tokens sent in each chat completion request

optional.name: request_timeout_seconds
optional.description: Timeout per request against the BNK Gateway

optional.name: prometheus_release_label
optional.description: Value of the `release` label Prometheus operator's serviceMonitorSelector matches

optional.name: client_image
optional.description: Base image (client source ships via ConfigMap + pip-install init container)
